text.zh-CN:
下背痛是肋骨下缘到臀部之间的疼痛，常会影响弯腰、行走和睡眠。

- 多数属于非特异性疼痛，意思是检查后不能归因于某个明确疾病，并不是疼痛不真实。
- 疼痛可以是酸胀、刺痛，也可能向腿部放射。
- 持续超过约三个月属于慢性阶段，需要关注活动能力和生活质量。
text.en:
Low back pain affects the area between the lower ribs and buttocks and can affect bending, walking and sleep.

- Most cases have no single identifiable disease; the pain is still real.
- Aching or sharp pain may spread into a leg.
- Pain lasting over about three months needs attention to function and quality of life.

text.zh-CN:
病因和加重因素并不总是同一回事。

- 肌肉拉伤、反复负重或久不活动可能与疼痛有关。
- 椎间盘或神经问题可以引起向腿放射的疼痛。
- 骨折、感染和肿瘤较少见，需要结合外伤、发热等线索排查。
text.en:
Causes and aggravating factors differ.

- Strain, repeated loading and inactivity may contribute.
- Disc or nerve problems can cause pain spreading down a leg.
- Fracture, infection and cancer are less common causes requiring assessment of warning signs.

text.zh-CN:
以下变化需要急诊评估。

- 双腿新发无力、麻木，尤其伴会阴或肛周感觉下降。
- 突然排尿困难、尿失禁或大便控制改变，可能涉及支配盆腔的神经。
- 严重事故后疼痛，或同时胸痛，不要仅按肌肉劳损处理。
text.en:
Seek emergency assessment for these changes.

- New weakness or numbness in both legs, especially around the genitals or anus.
- New difficulty urinating or loss of bladder or bowel control can signal nerve involvement.
- Pain after major trauma or with chest pain needs urgent evaluation.

text.zh-CN:
根据病程和伴随表现安排就医。

- 发热、寒战、明显不适，或疼痛突然很重、迅速恶化，应尽快评估。
- 居家处理数周仍不改善，或妨碍工作、睡眠和走路，应预约检查。
- 不明原因消瘦、夜间明显疼痛等变化要主动告诉医生。
text.en:
Use the course and associated symptoms to decide when to seek care.

- Fever, shaking or rapidly worsening severe pain needs prompt assessment.
- Arrange review if symptoms persist for weeks or limit daily life.
- Report unexplained weight loss or prominent night pain.

text.zh-CN:
评估首先寻找需要特别处理的原因。

- 医生会询问起病、外伤、腿部感觉以及大小便变化。
- 体格检查观察活动、肌力和感觉，帮助判断神经是否受影响。
- 检查方案应围绕怀疑的原因选择，不能仅凭疼痛程度自行判断病因。
text.en:
Assessment first looks for causes needing specific treatment.

- Describe onset, injury, leg symptoms and bladder or bowel changes.
- Movement, strength and sensation are examined for nerve involvement.
- Tests depend on the suspected cause; pain intensity alone cannot identify it.

text.zh-CN:
下背痛不一定都来自肌肉。

- 坐骨神经痛常包含向腿放射的疼痛，需要评估神经症状。
- 炎症性脊柱疾病、骨折或感染可能需要不同治疗。
- 肾脏等其他器官的问题也可能表现为背部疼痛。
text.en:
Pain in this area is not always muscular.

- Sciatic pain travels into a leg and calls for assessment of nerve symptoms.
- Inflammatory spinal disease, fracture or infection requires different care.
- Pain can also be referred from organs such as the kidneys.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标是恢复活动并处理明确病因。

- 在可耐受范围继续日常活动，避免长时间卧床。
- 物理治疗包括适合个人的活动和力量训练，不只是按摩。
- 持续疼痛可结合心理和社会支持；这不是把疼痛解释为想象。
text.en:
Treatment aims to restore activity and address any specific cause.

- Continue tolerable daily activity rather than prolonged bed rest.
- Physiotherapy includes tailored movement and strengthening.
- Persistent pain may benefit from psychological and social support; this does not imply imaginary pain.

text.zh-CN:
止痛药只能辅助缓解症状，不能替代活动恢复。

- 布洛芬等消炎止痛药可减轻疼痛，但可能引起胃溃疡或胃肠出血，也可能损伤肾脏。
- 有溃疡、心肾疾病、相关过敏史，或正在服抗凝药者，需先核对适用性；孕期不要自行使用。
- 不要自行叠加布洛芬、萘普生等同类药；按适合自己的最低有效剂量和最短疗程使用，避免长期自行加量。
text.en:
Pain medicines can support symptom relief but do not replace recovery of activity.

- Ibuprofen and similar anti-inflammatory drugs may relieve pain but can cause ulcers or gastrointestinal bleeding and kidney problems.
- Check suitability with a history of ulcers, heart or kidney disease, relevant allergy or anticoagulant use; do not self-use during pregnancy.
- Do not combine ibuprofen with similar medicines such as naproxen yourself. Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest suitable duration rather than escalating long-term use.

text.zh-CN:
饮食管理重点是均衡营养与合适体重。

- 维持均衡饮食与合适体重，可作为长期生活方式管理的一部分。
- 现有患者资料没有为所有下背痛提供统一的特殊食谱，饮食不能代替病因评估。
text.en:
Dietary care focuses on balanced nutrition and an appropriate weight.

- Balanced meals and appropriate weight management can support long-term care.
- The reviewed information provides no universal back-pain diet; diet cannot replace assessment.

text.zh-CN:
护理重点是逐步找回活动能力。

- 分次步行或改变坐姿，避免长时间保持同一姿势。
- 冷热敷时隔一层布，选择感觉舒适的方式。
- 运动使疼痛明显加重时暂停并咨询，不要强行完成固定次数。
text.en:
Self-care focuses on gradually regaining activity.

- Use short walks and changes of position.
- Wrap heat or cold packs in a cloth and use what feels comfortable.
- Stop an exercise that clearly worsens pain and seek guidance.

text.zh-CN:
不同人群需要调整活动和用药。

- 老年人及有其他疾病者，止痛药选择需额外核对。
- 体力劳动者可讨论减少反复负重、调整工作台和分担任务。
- 儿童和青少年也会背痛，持续或影响活动时应评估。
text.en:
Plans need to fit the person.

- Older adults and people with other illnesses need medicine-safety checks.
- Manual workers can discuss reducing repeated heavy loading, adapting the workstation and sharing tasks.
- Children and teenagers also have back pain; persistent pain or pain limiting activity warrants assessment.

text.zh-CN:
恢复速度因病因和持续时间而异。

- 许多短期发作在数周内改善，但可能再次发作。
- 长期疼痛的随访不只问痛几分，还要看睡眠、走路和工作能力。
- 出现新的无力或大小便变化，应提前就医，不等原定复诊。
text.en:
Recovery varies with cause and duration.

- Many short episodes improve within weeks, but recurrence is possible.
- Follow-up should assess sleep, walking and work as well as pain.
- New weakness or bladder or bowel changes requires earlier care.

text.zh-CN:
持续疼痛的影响可能超出腰部。

- 活动受限会影响工作、家务和社交。
- 睡眠差、情绪低落和对活动的担心可能与疼痛相互影响。
- 如果实际存在神经压迫等明确原因，需针对该原因处理。
text.en:
Persistent pain can affect more than the back.

- Reduced mobility may limit work, household tasks and social life.
- Poor sleep, distress and fear of movement may reinforce difficulties.
- A specific cause such as nerve involvement needs its own care plan.

text.zh-CN:
以下措施有助降低反复发作的风险。

- 保持适量活动、逐步增强体力，避免突然增加负荷。
- 调整工作环境和搬运方式，减少反复高强度受力。
- 不吸烟、改善睡眠并管理体重，可纳入长期计划。
text.en:
These measures can help reduce recurrence risk.

- Stay active and increase physical demands gradually.
- Adapt work and handling tasks to reduce repeated heavy strain.
- Include smoking avoidance, sleep and weight management in the long-term plan.

limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.
